plans.title: Architectural Plans Engine
plans.subtitle: Import, geometric calculation with decoupled AI, and 2D editor
plans.step1Desc: Metadata extraction, multi-format PDF/Raster support and resolution normalization.
plans.step2Desc: Orthogonal alignment, dimension line detection and precise metric calibration.
plans.step3Desc: Partition vectorization, thickness calculations and boundary topology closure.
plans.step4Desc: Space identification, usable surface calculation and door/window detection.
plans.bannerDesc: The engine interprets PDF or rasterized image plans, identifies load-bearing walls and partitions, calculates room polygons with the Gauss/Shoelace formula to obtain exact surfaces in m², locates doors and windows, and offers precise scale calibration.
plans.uploadDesc: Supported formats: Architectural PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG (up to 50 MB)
plans.module1Desc: Metadata extraction, multi-format PDF/Raster support, and resolution normalization.
plans.module2Desc: Reading architectural ratio (1:50, 1:100) and precise manual calibration by 2 reference points.
plans.module3Desc: Classification of exterior walls vs interior partitions, openings, and opening directions.
plans.module4Desc: Exact mathematical calculation of closed surfaces and validation of confidence levels.

furniture.title: Furniture Library
furniture.subtitle: Catalog management, custom pieces, and real dimensions
furniture.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete the furniture "{{name}}" from your library?
furniture.bannerDesc: Each element in the library stores its physical three-dimensional dimensions (width, depth, height). When dragged to the 2D plane, the collision and spatial validation engine checks passage clearances, door blockages, and calculates "Does it fit here?" compatibility.
furniture.noFurnitureDesc: Try another search term or create a new custom piece.
furniture.defineReal: Define the real metric dimensions of the furniture for spatial geometric validation.
furniture.egStructure: E.g. Oak structure with stain-repellent upholstery

viewer3d.title: 3D Engine & Digital Twin
viewer3d.subtitle: Conversion of 2D geometry to 3D meshes with Three.js / WebGL
viewer3d.captureSnapshot: Capture rendered image of the 3D view
viewer3d.moduleDesc: The 3D conversion engine generates extruded volumetric walls, triangulated floors and carpentry holes from the 2D model with orbit navigation, first person and dynamic lighting.
viewer3d.canvasDesc: The data of plans, walls, doors and rooms will be directly synchronized in interactive 3D meshes.
